supporting_observations.claim: The repeated failures target svc-inventory and originate from FILE-BLU-01, with the same source address (10.54.20.20) and process ID (0x97c) across the observed attempts.
Attempts recur at roughly one-minute intervals, consistent with the provided inventory context that InventorySync on FILE-BLU-01 runs every minute and re-authenticates each run.

The records show invalid-password/pre-authentication failures for svc-inventory, including 4625/4776 status 0xc000006a and 4771 status 0x18; the supplied records do not show a successful authentication.

The provided change calendar schedules svc-inventory's password rotation at 13:30 UTC and says the job must then be updated manually. The repeated failures from the scheduled-job host are consistent with the job continuing to use a stale password after rotation.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for PROXY-BLU-01 were not collected from 13:30 to 14:20 UTC because of a collection outage; this limits review of proxy activity but does not explain or establish the origin of these authentication failures.
The supplied authentication records cover attempts from 13:35:58 through 13:50:53 UTC, not the full requested 13:20–14:20 UTC interval.
claims_not_established: The records do not identify the specific InventorySync executable or job as the process initiating the authentications; the logged process is lsass.exe.
The records do not establish whether or when the InventorySync job was updated with the rotated password, or whether authentication later succeeded.
The available evidence does not establish malicious intent or credential guessing by an external or unauthorized source.
